changelog:
v5.0.3 — Adult content kept off Home + parental controls fix

• Adult (18+) titles and channels no longer appear anywhere on the Home screen — not in the featured banner, Trending, Top 10, recommendations, Continue Watching or Pick Up & New. They are still available inside their own category if you go looking for them.

• Fixed: on some older Fire TV Sticks, the app closed when you tried to create a parental controls PIN. Setting, entering and changing your PIN now works on every stick.

Includes everything from v5.0.2: dialogue plays in both ears, the channel surfing fix, Catch Up, and the redesigned movie pages.
